title: BJJ No Gi Wrist Lock Variations Tutorial
whyUseful: A no-gi specific survey of wrist lock variations, which is the right starting point for seeing how many entries share the same grip.

title: Triangle Wrist Lock by Matt Arroyo
whyUseful: Shows the wrist lock as a second attack from the triangle, which is exactly how the system is meant to be layered on an existing position.

title: Wristlock From Bottom Side by Felipe Pena
whyUseful: The bottom side control entry, useful for showing that the lock is available even when you are the one being pinned.
